articles.title: Cyclist in his 70s rushed to hospital after getting hit by a car in Etobicoke
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after a cyclist in his 70s was hit by a car on Saturday afternoon. Emergency crews were called to the area of Dixon and Royal York Roads just after 2 p.m. Paramedics told CityNews an “elderly man” was rushed to a hospital with serious and potentially life-threatening injuries. articles.title: Search underway for Canadian-registered air ambulance with 6 aboard missing off U.S. coast
articles.summary: A Hamilton-based plane with six people aboard, including four Canadians, went missing during a flight from Bermuda to Boston

articles.title: Woman, 22, charged after man stabbed at Mississauga bus terminal
articles.summary: A 22-year-old woman has been charged following a stabbing at Mississauga’s local bus terminal on Friday night. Police in Peel Region were on patrol in the terminal near Square One mall just after 9:30 p.m. when bystanders alerted them to an incident nearby. articles.title: 12-year-old boy hit by a car in Lawrence Park area
articles.summary: A 12-year-old boy was rushed to a hospital on Friday evening after getting hit by a car in the Lawrence Park neighbourhood. articles.title: 16-year-old charged with manufacturing firearm parts, threatening Pickering school
articles.summary: Police say a 16-year-old boy is facing charges after allegedly threatening to carry out a shooting at a Pickering, Ont., high school and making firearm parts with a 3D printer.

articles.title: Man, 35, dead after hit and run in Scarborough, police say
articles.summary: A 35-year-old man is dead after a hit and run in Scarborough early Friday, police say.

articles.title: The battle between Mississauga's current and ex mayor
articles.summary: Mississauga’s current and former mayors are at odds, and the political fallout is making waves. CBC's Chris Glover speaks with two guests to analyze the high-stakes dynamic between Carolyn Parrish and Bonnie Crombie. Tune in to hear what’s driving this rivalry and what it means for local voter turnout.
